why: The 5Rs is a named learning-dispositions framework developed and packaged by the Campaign for Learning as part of the Mind the Gap family-learning programme, not a general explanatory learning theory.
name: Mind the Gap
product_description: The Campaign for Learning's Mind the Gap family-learning programme uses the 5Rs framework—Readiness, Resourcefulness, Resilience, Responsibility and Reflectiveness—to structure metacognitive learning activities for primary-aged children and their families.
